issue_context.title: Software decoder fallback is needed for h264 (High 4:4:4 Predictive) on AndroidMediaCodec
issue_context.body:
<!--- Please fill out this template to the best of your ability. You can always edit this issue once you have created it. -->
<!--- Read the following link before you create a new problem report: https://kodi.wiki/view/HOW-TO:Submit_a_bug_report  -->
## Bug report
### Describe the bug
<!--- Provide a more detailed introduction to the issue itself, and why you consider it to be a bug -->
<!--- A bug report that is not clear will be closed -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
Video playback of the following type fails when MediaCodec is active on Android:

Video: h264 (High 4:4:4 Predictive), yuv444p10le(progressive)
Format profile                           : High 4:4:4 Predictive@L5

However, It succeeds when MediaCodec is manually disabled.

## Expected Behavior
Here is a clear and concise description of what was expected to happen:
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
Software fallback is triggered for this H.264 profile type and playback occurs.

## Actual Behavior
<!--- Tell us what happens instead -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
Kodi attempts playback using MediaCodec, fails and hangs with a perpetual loading animation
This is the Identical behavior as to what happened for FF_PROFILE_HEVC_REXT before
https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/pull/18926/commits/04666bdde0a2f11c9213d31e2deb356d77aaaafe

## Possible Fix
<!--- Not obligatory, but suggest a fix or reason for the bug -->
<!--- Put your text below this line -->
Add software fallback exception for all types of hi10p H.264 profiles to
https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/blob/master/xbmc/cores/VideoPlayer/DVDCodecs/Video/DVDVideoCodecAndroidMediaCodec.cpp#L462 under "case AV_CODEC_ID_H264:"

      case FF_PROFILE_H264_HIGH_10:
      case FF_PROFILE_H264_HIGH_10_INTRA:
      case FF_PROFILE_H264_HIGH_422:
      case FF_PROFILE_H264_HIGH_422_INTRA:
      case FF_PROFILE_H264_HIGH_444_PREDICTIVE:
      case FF_PROFILE_H264_HIGH_444_INTRA:
      case FF_PROFILE_H264_CAVLC_444:
          // No known h/w decoder supporting Hi10P
          goto FAIL;

review_comments: should there be a  `default:` case here also?

I was thinking more to fail for uncaught profiles, but I guess this wouldn't work for regular h264 profiles?

I'm not sure breaking here is what you want as it won't set the mime and formatname for profiles not captured in the switch/case.

It's a switch in a switch. It will just continue after the profile switch, which it was done before. The profile is only used for checking before opening:
https://github.com/xbmc/xbmc/blob/774171d3bb8927f992758001e495d8315a1e09d4/xbmc/cores/VideoPlayer/DVDCodecs/Video/DVDVideoCodecAndroidMediaCodec.cpp#L664 here

Standard AVC was already opened, without prior checking.
